exposure: percent weight lost at time of discharge
cohort: 215 infants rehospitalized from March 1, 2019 to March 1, 2021
finding: Infants born during the COVID-19 pandemic had a 51% increased odds of rehospitalization ≤7 days of discharge from WBN compared with prepandemic infants.
mod_finding: While this study found that newborns born during the pandemic had shorter newborn nursery stays and higher rates of rehospitalization within 7 days of birth, particularly for hyperbilirubinemia, mode of delivery was adjusted for in the analysis.
